title: relgap audit --format json
description: The report-v1.json envelope with audit data: the OSV advisories that affect the pinned tool versions under the roots, and the tool versions OSV wasn't asked about.

checked.description: Distinct tool versions OSV answered for, with or without findings.

findings.description: One entry per advisory and tool version, sorted by severity (unknown last), then by ID, tool and version.

unchecked.description: Tool versions OSV wasn't asked about, grouped by tool, version and reason, with the pins that resolve to no tool last. Never reported as clean.

oldest_answer.description: With --offline: when the oldest OSV answer the report uses was stored in the cache.

tool.description: The pins' tool, as relgap digest accepts it.

version.description: The version OSV was asked about: the exact pin, or the version a pin marked ≈ stands for.

pins.description: Every pin of this tool version, sorted by repo, file and line.

id.description: The OSV ID of the advisory.

fixed_in.description: Lowest fixed version above the version.
